create.name: Rev. Skip Jennings
create.bio:
Rev. Skip Jennings is a New Thought minister, coach, yoga teacher and author based in Los Angeles. He trained for the ministry at Agape University's Michael Bernard Beckwith School of Ministry, belongs to the Religious Science movement (Centers for Spiritual Living), and is an assistant minister at the Religious Science church in North Hollywood, having earlier been spiritual director of a centre in Fort Lauderdale. He came to yoga through a single class in 1996 and has spent more than twenty years weaving fitness, yoga and metaphysical study together.

His teaching draws on Science of Mind: the idea that a change in thinking changes a life, put into practice through affirmation, gratitude, visioning, meditation and gentle movement. He coaches people one to one using a framework he calls C.A.R.E.S., leads workshops, a weekly midweek meditation and service on Zoom, and retreats, including one in Santorini for people in their fifties and beyond. His books include a thirty-one-day devotional, The Little Book for Big Transformations; Spirit Explosion, a mix of poems, affirmations and writing prompts; and The Lotus Kitchen, a vegetarian cookbook with yoga notes written with caterer Gwen Kenneally.

books.title: The Little Book for Big Transformations (Second Edition): 31 Days of Inner Visions and Spiritual Practices
books.author: Skip Jennings
books.description: A month of short daily readings, each pairing a teaching with an affirmation. It is meant to be worked through one day at a time and returned to, as a steady habit of positive, loving thought.

books.title: Spirit Explosion: A Time for GOD, Love, and Transformation
books.author: Skip Jennings
books.description: Skip's account of his own path towards an awareness of God, set out in thirty-three stages. Each stage has one of his poems, an affirmation and a writing exercise, with some of his own artwork.

books.title: The Lotus Kitchen
books.author: Skip Jennings, Gwen Kenneally
books.description: An illustrated vegetarian cookbook written with Hollywood caterer Gwen Kenneally, with a foreword by Michael Bernard Beckwith. Recipes sit alongside simple yoga movements and meditation ideas for mindful eating.

courses.title: Spiritual Empowerment Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching built on his C.A.R.E.S. framework, mixing spiritual principles, changes in mindset and practical daily steps. Sessions can also include private yoga, meditation with sound, or visioning in the style taught by Michael Bernard Beckwith. A free fifteen-minute first call is offered.

courses.title: 50 and Beyond Tribe Retreat: The Next Chapter, Santorini
courses.description: An eight-day retreat in Santorini, Greece, for people in their fifties and older. Mornings begin with meditation and movement, followed by teaching sessions based on his forthcoming book on thriving after fifty, with island tours, a cooking class and free time.

courses.title: Meditation 101
courses.description: A five-day beginners' course on Insight Timer covering the basics of sitting practice. A gentle starting point for anyone new to meditation.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: The Power of Gratitude
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course on gratitude as a daily spiritual practice. Each session offers a short teaching and reflection.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Rev. Skip Jennings on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free guided meditations, affirmations and short spiritual talks, many on gratitude and mindful living. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Midweek Spiritual Boost (Wednesday evenings)
free_resources.description: A weekly live meditation and service on Zoom on Wednesday evenings at 7pm Pacific, led by Skip as assistant minister. Open to anyone who wants to join.
